summary: We built RoboBee Health Guardian, an autonomous deep-space crew health monitoring platform featuring Lunar, a hands-free Gemini voice and webcam companion paired with an interactive 3D anatomical whole-body hologram. Grounded in NASA's Five Hazards of Human Spaceflight and live NASA Open APIs (DONKI, OSDR, NTRS), the system tracks heart rate, SpO2, cuffless blood pressure timing, core temperature, blood glucose, hydration, habitat CO2, and radiation alongside daily mood and ultrasound check-ins. When anomalies or discomfort occur, Lunar autonomously zooms the 3D body to the target region, logs persistent symptom follow-ups, and compares live conditions against historical mission precedents (including Apollo 13 CO2, Skylab, and ISS SANS) to surface verification steps—even offline during 20-minute Mars communication delays. By separating deterministic Python safety rules from conversational AI, it empowers self-reliant astronaut care far from Earth.
details:
WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

RoboBee Health Guardian (AstroHealth Guardian v2.0) is an autonomous astronaut health console built with Python (FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic, NumPy, SQLite) and an interactive WebGL frontend (Three.js, HTML5, CSS3). It streams 1 Hz real-time or simulated telemetry across 8 operational scenarios (Scenarios A–H, including exercise workload, sleep deficit, ECLSS CO2 excursion, fall detection, and Solar Particle Event radiation), while preserving strict provenance labels separating LIVE hardware sensor ingest (/api/telemetry/ingest) from simulated baseline feeds and unmeasured MISSING channels.

Crew members interact hands-free with "Lunar" over bidirectional WebSocket native audio (/ws/lunar/live), webcam affect check-ins (/api/lunar/vision-check), and a 3D whole-body hologram. When an astronaut reports pain or an injury (e.g., shoulder strain or a cut finger), Lunar zooms the 3D hologram to the exact region, logs a persistent SQLite symptom ticket with a 3D pain marker that only clears upon crew-confirmed follow-up, and evaluates the alert against NASA's Five Hazards and 7 grounded historical spaceflight precedents (Apollo 13 CO2, Skylab 2 arrhythmia, ISS SANS/IJV thrombosis, Skylab 4 strain, EVA-23 hypoxia, Apollo SPE radiation, Mir environmental/metabolic events).

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

1. Deep-Space Autonomy: Operates local-first with cached NASA DONKI, OSDR, and NTRS feeds plus a Mars 20-minute communication lag ("MARS 20m LAG • OFFLINE") mode when Earth medical support is unreachable.

2. Preventive Crew Compliance: Tracks daily hydration (mL), blood glucose (mg/dL), mood scores (1–5), and SANS/IJV ultrasound checks with SQLite streaks, XP, and mission badges.

3. Zero-Scroll Hands-Free Cockpit: Designed so critical vitals, cabin webcam, 3D explorer, and voice feedback fit cleanly on one screen without mouse navigation.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES, HARDWARE & SOFTWARE

- Backend: Python 3.13, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2, NumPy, HTTPX, WebSockets, SQLite, pytest (41 automated tests passing).

- Frontend & 3D: Vanilla JavaScript ES Modules, Three.js (Draco & Meshoptimizer GLB decompression for BodyParts3D and Écorché anatomical geometry), Web Audio API PCM streaming (16kHz capture / 24kHz playback with client + server Acoustic Echo Gate), and laptop cabin webcam capture.

- AI / Super Intelligence (SI) Integration: Google GenAI SDK (gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-latest, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts) and Antigravity AI coding assistance.

- Wearable Concept: Compact ESP32-series controller with MAX30102 PPG/SpO2, 3-electrode ECG (Pulse Arrival Time blood-pressure timing research concept), IMU/gyro, OLED display, and optional HuskyLens 2 / cabin webcam vision adapter.

CREATIVITY & FACTORS CONSIDERED

- Non-Diagnostic Engineering Guardrail: All thresholds, Z-score anomaly detection (Rules 1–10), historical incident scoring, and provenance checks are computed deterministically in Python outside LLM prompts. Lunar uses an output sanitizer so it never issues clinical diagnoses or medication prescriptions.

- Privacy, Reliability & Accessibility: Built with keyboard navigation, ARIA live regions, continuous single-voice audio, explicit webcam consent boundaries, and full prompt-by-prompt AI disclosure in docs/AI_USE.md.

USE OF SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI) DISCLOSURE (AUDIO, CODE & DATA)

- Audio: Lunar's spoken voice responses are generated in real time using Google Gemini Native Audio / TTS (not human voice actors). No NASA logos, flags, or mission badges are generated by SI.

- Code & Data: Portions of application boilerplate, UI styling, and pytest scaffolding were generated with the Antigravity AI coding assistant under human architectural direction and logged chronologically in docs/AI_USE.md. Physiological formulas, database state, and alerts run deterministically in Python code.
